{{- /* creator/breadcrumbs.html — Home / ancestor folders / (current). (dict "page" "node" "nodes") */ -}} {{- if $.page.Site.Params.breadcrumbs -}}
{{ i18n "creator.garden" }} {{- $parts := split $.node.slug "/" -}} {{- if gt (len $parts) 1 -}} {{- range $i := seq 1 (sub (len $parts) 1) -}} {{- $anc := delimit (first $i $parts) "/" -}} {{- range first 1 (where $.nodes "slug" $anc) -}} /{{ .title }} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}}
{{- end -}}
